_provenance: Manual review of the 120 sampled questions in evals/golden/to_review.jsonl, performed by Claude (an AI) - not by an attorney and not by the repository owner. Method: 22 questions flagged by automated heuristics (short answer, answer starting mid-sentence, gold chunk missing category vocabulary, more than 3 gold chunks) were read in full alongside their gold answer and gold chunk text; a random sample of 12 unflagged questions was also read to check the unflagged bucket. Most flags were false positives - dates are legitimately short, and 'no less than 50%' is a minimum commitment my keyword list missed. Cite as AI-reviewed, not human-verified.
_key_format: doc_id|category  (stable across regeneration; question ids are reassigned each run)
